age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

hand.Description: Handedness of the participant (all participants were right-handed according to the paper).

Description: Participant list (17 healthy controls, 20 ICH patients). Age, sex, weight and height per participant are not released; the paper reports 8 female / 29 male, aged 20-65.

group.Description: Participant group, from the depositor's folder (Normals = healthy controls, Patients = ICH patients).

bci_experience.Description: BCI experience level of the participant

source_folder.Description: The depositor's folder holding this participant's EEG epoch files in figshare article 28955456 v4 (folder_structure of the article record); the files are under sourcedata/ at the same path.

n_sessions.Description: Number of sessions (consecutive runs of one visit) released for this participant.
